$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: Accepting a capability that was not offered is invalid

rejection.rule: Accepted capabilities MUST be a subset of the offered set and MUST include camera_agent_interaction_v2; accepting generated_visual_guidance_v2 additionally requires the v1 hello capabilities high_resolution_request and sample_image. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)
rejection.effect: Acceptance is invalid; the desktop emits protocol_error_v2 unsupported_capability and wire mode does not switch to v2.

summary: The offer advertises only camera_agent_interaction_v2, but the acceptance selects generated_visual_guidance_v2 as well. The selected visual bundle was not offered, so acceptance is invalid.

steps.note: Offer advertises only the mandatory interaction bundle; the visual bundle is not offered. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1)
Acceptance selects generated_visual_guidance_v2, which was not offered. Acceptance is invalid; no switch. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)

outcome: Wire mode remains v1. The phone MUST NOT treat an invalid acceptance as a v2 switch.
